name: P07 — WHY does the ease-behind work on the frozen clock and not on the real one?

steps.note: W1. The instrument records the GATE, not the result: p.speed (is he 'moving' at all?), moveT (has the 0.55s hold expired?), manualT (is the ease-behind branch even open?), and yawT (did the boom move?). Sampled EVERY rendered frame on the real clock.
